title: Release A, package 2: the new pictures and card faces in the game; shared motion blocks
problem: The game still shows the old pictures and the old card faces, and its animations are built from separate pieces with their own timings. The approved designs (docs/studio/review-18/mockups) and the drawn pictures (docs/studio/art-drafts/cards-18) are not in the game yet.
scope: Every new picture is in the game: 36 customers, 8 standing-order clients, 20 events and Calm Day, 8 shopkeeper scenes, 6 favours, 5 upgrades, 6 back patterns; each with a focus point so narrow frames keep the subject

Card faces follow the approved designs wherever a card is drawn: event, lorry, shopkeeper, favour, upgrade and standing order in design A; the customer front and back as on the Main board; pattern backs; the label "Upgrade"
Card wording comes from the game's data as it is today; the text rewrite is package 4

Shared motion blocks from the flow study (section F, step 1): timings named in one place and one speed for scripts and stylesheets; one shared move with a soft landing and calls on lift-off and landing; a sheet that slides in and out for the middle panel; a count of slow frames in the performance budget
exclusions: Rebuilding the screens and their beats (package 3): layouts stay as they are apart from the cards themselves
The text rewrite (package 4), trophies and the stamp book (package 5), the print kit (package 6)
